string.name: help_open_body
string.value: Create a document or choose a file on the home page, or open a supported file from another app. Opened and saved documents cannot exceed 8 MiB. If the original file cannot be written, you can save a copy; editing then continues in the new file. Saving keeps the original encoding and LF, CRLF, and CR line endings. The document page can share the current content, including unsaved changes. The shared file is a temporary copy and does not overwrite the original. Deleting moves the original file to the system trash and warns about unsaved changes. Deletion is unavailable when access is insufficient or another app has changed the file. Settings can follow the system language or use Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, or Russian. Returning to the system language takes effect the next time the app opens. Other languages are shown in Simplified Chinese.

string.name: help_edit_body
string.value: Switch among preview, edit, and outline at the bottom of the document. Markdown and LaTeX documents have an outline. On a wide screen, split view shows the preview and the editor together. When the document list and the document are shown side by side, use the title-bar button to expand the document or restore the list, or close the document from its menu. The More menu can find text, move between matches, and replace one match at a time.

string.name: help_format_body
string.value: Markdown, plain text, SVG, and LaTeX files are supported. Markdown can show local images in the document directory or its subdirectories when the system allows them to be read. Network images and images without access are shown as placeholders. LaTeX can preview common documents and math; it does not compile PDF. Some commands, referenced images, and TikZ graphics cannot be shown yet.

string.name: help_draft_body
string.value: A draft is saved on the device while you edit, so it can be restored after an unexpected exit. If a file is opened from another app then, the app returns to the document page and asks whether to save the previous edits before opening the new file. Recent documents lists only files with persistent access. The More menu can change the sort order, and a long press can remove a record. A document can be added to or removed from favorites, and the home page can switch to the favorites list. A document that has not been saved, or that cannot be given persistent access, must be saved or saved as a new file before it can be added to favorites.

string.name: help_feedback_body
string.value: In Settings, tap Feedback to send a message with the mail app, or send mail directly to zhouyi1227@outlook.com.

string.name: privacy_body
string.value: Documents are edited on this device. The app has no account, ads, telemetry, or network interface, and it does not upload documents. Files are authorized by the system file picker, and drafts are stored in the app’s private directory.
